text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Ultimate Performance buys nothing here (dots are the individual runs)
Runs alternated Balanced/Ultimate/Ultimate/Balanced so thermal drift cannot favour either. Ultimate Performance sets PCIe ASPM to Off
(from Maximum power savings) and minimum processor state to 100% (from 5%); the effective clock came out 189% vs 187% of base either way.
No code changed between the two: both columns are rsync 3.5.0 Windows port at a8664bae, only the Windows power plan differs.
Windows: Dell Latitude 7490, i5-8350U (4 cores / 8 threads, 15 W) · Linux: Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U · Thunderbolt networking, MTU 65330, link 20 Gbit/s
rsync 3.5.0 Windows port, github.com/nuket/rsync-windows · aes128-gcm, source file warm in the page cache · © 2026 Max Vilimpoc
